BiblicalUsage: Hûwk is the Aramaic word for going and bringing, and it runs through Ezra's record of the return from exile. In Ezra 7:13, the text says "which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem." In Ezra 6:5, the text says "and brought again unto the temple which [is] at Jerusalem."
TheologicalSignificance: hûwk convinces me that the journey matters as much as the destination, because God walks it with His people. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
